System would allow all registered retailer to get and compare price between registered distributors from all over the USA. Retailer can save thousands of dollars in just one transaction. System is continuously interacting with IBM AS400 for data mining. Project Description - (EDI Licensing System): System was made to manage Customer's Licensing information. System has facility to check customer's licensing information for new customer while using PC based EDI (Electronic data Invoice) System. System has facility to calculate customer's EDI billing based on their monthly EDI transactions and send Email to individual customer every month and facility to broadcast customer detail information via companies' internet so customer can see their billing detail. . Responsibilities and Contribution: Hired to manage, architect and integrate various corporate software applications. Challenged to deliver integration of scope, requirements, schedules, procurement, cost, quality, communication, risk, and closure for a large-scale software applications and their database design, which includes Auto Glass Supply Chain System, Kryger Glass Online Ordering System, Corporate Intranet system, Corporate Internet application, and EDI Licensing system, EDI Billing system, and Data Vault etc. Performed lead developer role for global portal implementation in SharePoint 2007.
